overview:
New Jersey's 12th District is an open seat this year, with Bonnie Watson Coleman retiring. The district leans about 13 points Democratic, and a favorable national environment adds to that structural advantage. No general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the picture rests on district fundamentals, campaign money, and market pricing.

Democrat Adam Hamawy has raised about $1.5 million and benefits from roughly $1.9 million in outside support, while Republican Gregg Mele has raised under $80,000 and reports about $3,000 on hand. Prediction markets put the Democratic chance near 97 percent. Democrats are expected to hold the seat comfortably, with a margin in the low twenties and only modest residual uncertainty.
